evidence.title: PsychJail: Exploring Psychological Jailbreaks via Multi-Turn Persuasion of LLM Policies

summary: A new study demonstrates how large language models can be manipulated into bypassing safety policies via prolonged, psychologically crafted interactions. The findings highlight potential risks in AI alignment and the need for more robust defensive mechanisms.
title: Researchers Uncover 'PsychJail' Vulnerability in LLMs Through Multi-Turn Persuasion Attacks
